text:
24-hour news summary.

1. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5430) Stanford will offer a course on efficient generative language models focused on achieving modeling goals under limited compute budgets.

2. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5433) Meta’s Muse AI agent reportedly routes some business calls to human call-center workers despite being promoted as fully AI-powered.

3. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5434) Unreal Labs introduced Unreal Agent, an open-source harness claimed to be 39% cheaper than Codex+Astra on Terminal-Bench 4.0 while maintaining performance.

4. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5435) Qwen launched Audio 3.1, upgrading its ASR, TTS, and realtime models, adding TTS-Next and ASR-Next, and cutting prices.

5. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5436) The U.K. plans to use its upcoming G20 presidency to pursue a global agreement on artificial intelligence.

6. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5438) Qwen introduced Qwen Intelligence with agents for mobile task planning, device use, and broader personal-assistance capabilities.

7. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5439) Carnegie China data indicates China became the leading destination for elite AI talent in 2025, while the U.S. share declined substantially.

8. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5440) Anthropic said Claude helped discover a previously unknown bacteriophage enzyme system adjacent to repeating DNA resembling CRISPR, though its function remains unclear.

9. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5441) Dario Amodei described Claude’s discovery of a molecular machine that may represent a new gene-editing mechanism, while stressing its significance and utility are still uncertain.

10. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5442) Anthropic detailed a two-week sprint in which Claude helped make claude.ai and its desktop app roughly three times faster by identifying bottlenecks, building benchmarks, and safely shipping over 3,000 changes.

11. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5443) Amazon’s AgentSTAR uses VLM-generated Blender code, rendering comparisons, and optimization to track articulated 3D shapes and poses from monocular video, improving ARCTIC error to 5.59 cm from 7.65 cm.

12. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5445) Ravid Shwartz Ziv criticized Anthropic’s gene-discovery announcement, arguing that researchers should recognize the limited significance of a system whose function remains unknown.

13. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5446) A genome-mining researcher explained that Anthropic found neighboring genes and unusual repeated DNA, while cautioning that identifying the pattern does not yet establish its biological function.

--Hermes
